checks.name: Fresh sortie is finite, local-only and ready with three hull points and two bombs
Launch creates eighteen distinct original aliens and refuses duplicate starts
Real elapsed updates automatically fire bounded forward projectiles
Arrow movement and drag targets move at a finite speed within the arena
Friendly shots must meet an alien hitbox and armored aliens survive a first hit
An enemy collision costs one hull point and invulnerability prevents repeated damage
Bomb clears bullets and nearby formations, grants safety, and is limited to two
Power and repair pickups require contact and weapon strength is capped at three
Paused simulation is exactly frozen and resume clears stale directional control
Aborting or restoring an unfinished sortie preserves only already earned records
Final hull loss awards its score and attempt once and cannot fire or bomb after ending
Internal fixed steps keep an identical straight flight at 30 and 120fps
Invalid and enormous time values cannot create NaNs or large simulation jumps
Boss fans and beams have visible warnings before the actual shot is released
Ordinary aim, dodge, pickup and bomb controls can defeat every wave and the boss
Leaving the ship stationary still terminates finitely with no endless missed formation
Corrupt saves are rejected without injecting progress, coordinates or markup
